relevance_note: Single case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant: "This revealed a heterozygous de novo LAMP2 frameshift mutation (c.406dupA, p.T136NfsTer3)".
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script from values chosen by reading. Single unnamed patient labelled 'patient' (rule 5). First author surname taken as 'Alak' from the header author list (header lists surname first, e.g. 'Tinaz Selin Abdu' vs contributor 'Selin Abdu Tinaz'); contributor list prints 'Çetin Alak', so the surname is uncertain. Age 36 is at presentation; she died 6 months later; age at death not stated as a number so deceased_age_iso8601 left null. De novo recorded from 'heterozygous de novo' plus 'absent in population databases and parental testing'; the paper does not say explicitly that both parents were tested. Pathogenicity class not stated (only 'confirming Danon disease'). The text says 'no overt wall motion abnormalities were noted on standard imaging' but detailed analysis found subtle hypokinesis; only the hypokinesis was recorded (not treated as contradiction, since the statements concern different analyses). Figure 1 legend findings (biatrial enlargement, RV normal size with mildly reduced systolic function, LGE burden ~25%) were used as paper text. 'No family history of cardiomyopathy, sudden death, or neuromuscular disease' concerns relatives, not the patient, so excludes nothing. Heart failure not marked on the checklist because the paper never uses that term, though it reports dyspnoea and reduced EF. LVH excluded from 'wall thickness within normal limits' (D-27) and 'without hypertrophy'. No supplementary text available.
